description: This Java class implements a JSON deserializer using the JJWT library, converting JSON strings into Java objects like Maps and Lists. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.jwt package and provides singleton access to the deserializer.

classes.name: JjwtDeserializer
classes.description: A singleton final class that implements a JSON deserializer using the JJWT library, converting JSON strings into Java objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JjwtDeserializer.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a byte array containing JSON data into a Java object (Map, List, etc.).

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a Java object.

methods.name: toJavaMap
methods.description: Converts a JsonObject into a Java Map.

methods.name: toJavaList
methods.description: Converts a JsonArray into a List of Java objects.

methods.name: toJavaObject
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue into its corresponding Java object representation.
